status.headline: No measurements exist yet.
status.detail: The design is frozen first and measured second. This page is built from a report bundle that contains no trials, so it shows the pre-registered hypotheses, arms and task tiers and no figures at all. Nothing here has been measured; nothing here is an estimate.
